verdict.rationale: Alma is a tech-enabled immigration law firm with an online portal and a case-management system for companies, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of service. The evidence pack never mentions a CLI: the docs cover visa guides, pricing and the web portal, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. An llms.txt file exists, but that is an adjacent agent-readability feature, not a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
